scope: Native Firestore copy-claim and Cloud Storage restore-abandon component verification; not a full restore

environment.clients: Two independent Firestore SDK clients in one process; one client closed and reconstructed before abandonment

assertions: Only one competing transaction performed the original Storage copy
Original operation readback returned the same generation
Reconstructed client completed abandonment and replay wrote no second marker
Source bytes remained unchanged until planned synthetic source removal
Permanent non-content marker and authenticated isolated intents remain
retained: Encrypted isolated checkpoint/intents and one permanent non-content marker; synthetic source removed at its pinned generation. No user data, journal, control or deployment changed.

costs.actualBill: Not measured; bounded calls use existing synthetic resources

limitations: Synthetic provenance/auth/journal hashes exercise this component only; no real journal or full backup/restore operator run
Does not verify product avatar admission, native query indexes, API replicas or cleanup scheduling
No production control, deployment, release gate or account changes
Cloud soft-delete retention is unchanged; 404 is not proof of immediate physical erasure
Device appearance and Web/Android EXIF agreement remain unverified
